items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-06-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You don't recognize that man's name, Austin Crawford? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. Now you know, you know, you put a highway. You have to leave. You have to leave. You have to leave with London. And you go into the journey. Man, they got a highway. Beautiful. I'm telling you, Jesus Christ. It's a beautiful highway. Oh, man.
You don't recognize that man's name, Austin Crawford? You know, he's a Crawford cousin all the time?
